summary: Iter38 full regression on /app/builds (BUILD presets + expandable saved builds) and /app/upgrade (hw-header, installed-games chips, before-vs-after FPS compare). All 6 backend endpoints pass with real Claude calls. Frontend playwright covered every requested data-testid flow end-to-end and all assertions succeeded. Note: the routes are /app/builds (plural) and /app/upgrade — problem statement said /app/build but code uses /app/builds; not a bug, just a naming note.
action_items: OPTIONAL: doc/spec correction — the Build page route is /app/builds (plural), not /app/build. The one-click preset cards (competitive/streaming/ultra) all work at that URL.
critical_code_review_comments: BuildGenerator.jsx (line ~187-219): when a fresh AI result is set, the saved-builds list is hidden by the `!result && !loading` guard. After clicking Save the newly-saved build appears only if the user reloads the page (as the test flow does) — a lighter UX would be to keep the saved-list visible after save or auto-hide the just-generated card. Non-blocking.

Upgrade.jsx (line ~26): the same `game` state is shared between the FPS-estimate panel and the ba-game-input inside the before/after block. This creates coupling (clicking a fps-chip pre-fills ba-game-input and vice-versa). Works as tested, but consider decoupling if the two panels should behave independently in the future.
seed_data_creation: None. Used already-seeded pc_specs (i7-12700K / RTX 3070 Ti / 32GB) and 5 seeded games. Test creates and then deletes one AI-generated saved build.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: from landing page click 'Sign in' link (NOT direct navigation to /auth/login — that redirects to landing). After login navigate via sidebar 'Build Advisor' -> /app/builds and 'Upgrade & FPS' -> /app/upgrade. All new testids used: build-preset-{competitive|streaming|ultra}, saved-build-{id}, saved-build-detail-{id}, track-build-{id}, delete-build-{id}, hw-header, fps-chip-{game}, ba-chip-{game}, ba-game-input, ba-compare-btn, before-after-block, ba-result, ba-gain, ba-row-0..3, upg-rec-{i}. AI endpoints (builds/generate, upgrade/analyze, fps/upgrade-compare, fps/estimate) all responded < 30s in this run. Backend test uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL loaded from /app/frontend/.env when env var missing.

detailed_results.backend_pytest: 6/6 passed in 20.6s — pc-specs seeded, games seeded, builds list, fps/upgrade-compare (returns 4 estimates + gain_pct + notes + confidence), fps/estimate, upgrade/analyze

frontend_playwright.builds_presets: 3/3 preset cards visible with €1200/€1800/€3000 budgets. Competitive preset click -> AI generated build in ~15s -> save-build-btn appeared -> saved -> reload -> saved-build-{id} visible.
frontend_playwright.expandable_saved_build: Header click expands (detail visible), track button click keeps it expanded (stopPropagation OK), header click collapses, delete button removes the item.
frontend_playwright.upgrade_hw_header: Shows 'Detected hardware Intel Core i7-12700K NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti RAM 32 GB' — all specs present.
frontend_playwright.installed_games_chips: 5/5 fps-chips visible; clicking a chip fills fps-game-input.
frontend_playwright.analyze_upgrade: OK — upg-rec-0 rendered; before-after-block appears below.
frontend_playwright.before_after_compare: ba-game-input visible, ba-chip-* rendered, ba-compare-btn disabled when input empty, chip fills the input, ba-result rendered with +28% gain badge and 4 rows with before→after bars.
frontend_playwright.i18n: IT: hardware rilevato, i tuoi giochi, prima vs dopo all present. EN: detected hardware, your games, before vs after all present. 'preset rapidi'/'quick presets' only appear on /app/builds so not found while on /app/upgrade — expected, not a bug.
